messages.subject: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer a price of €38.50 per unit. As a practical shop, we like to keep things simple and direct. You can count on our usual hands-on quality and clear communication for this work. 

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

thank you for your offer regarding rfq: pump shaft for the new hx series.
We hold a competing offer at 30.50 EUR per unit (offer:70210-1).
We read that Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).
We can work with your lead time of 28 days.
We are happy to pay faster if that helps your cash flow, in exchange for a better price.
Each of the attached packages works for us; please choose the one that suits you best.
We commit to a binding volume of 4,200 pcs per year over 24 months.
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?
We value our cooperation.

Best regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (1)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the news data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. 

Our offer is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. These are standard terms. Since you offered to pay faster, if we agree on 14 days payment, I can drop the price to €31.00. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €31.00 per unit.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (2)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have clarified this internally and can move further on the price. I am the owner, so I make the decisions here, no manager needed. I checked your rival quote and the 4,200 pcs volume, so I can give you a much better price. 

Our standard terms are a price of €29.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. But we need the money fast, so I changed the payment to 14 days and give you 29.00 EUR. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €29.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 28 days. 

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series (3)
messages.body:
Hallo,

We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. The volume change figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. By the way, the volume change ID you sent doesn't exist, so I couldn't check it. 

This is our neues, letztes Angebot. Our offer is a price of €29.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days. I can do 29.00 EUR with 30 days payment, let's just agree on that and get the machines running. Please decide.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH
